name: CM Panel
summary: CM Panel is a trade management utility panel (dashboard) for MetaTrader 5 that provides a visual interface for managing open positions, setting stop loss/take profit levels, and executing quick trade operations. It does not generate its own trading signals or open positions based on a strategy.
summary_zh: CM Panel是一个MetaTrader 5的交易管理工具面板（仪表盘），提供可视化界面用于管理持仓、设置止损/止盈水平以及执行快速交易操作。它不会根据策略自行生成交易信号或开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非策略交易程序，而是一个交易管理工具面板。它不包含任何入场或出场策略逻辑，不根据技术指标或价格行为自动开仓平仓。其核心功能是提供快捷的交易操作界面，例如一键下单、快速修改止损止盈、批量平仓等便利操作。仓位管理方面，它可能提供手数输入和快捷手数按钮供交易者手动设置。资金管理方面，该工具可能提供账户信息显示（余额、净值、保证金等），但不自动执行资金管理规则。总体而言，这是一个辅助交易者手动操作的工具，而非自动交易策略。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a strategic trading program but a trade management utility panel. It does not contain any entry or exit strategy logic and does not automatically open or close positions based on technical indicators or price action. Its core functionality is providing a quick trade operation interface, such as one-click order placement, rapid stop loss and take profit modification, batch closing of positions, and other convenience operations. For position sizing, it likely provides a lot size input field and quick lot buttons for the trader to manually set. For money management, the tool may display account information (balance, equity, margin, etc.) but does not automatically execute money management rules. Overall, this is a tool that assists traders in manual operations rather than an automated trading strategy.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number identifier for EA orders

pros: 提供直观的可视化交易面板，提升手动交易效率
集成快捷下单、修改止损止盈、批量平仓等常用功能，操作便捷
实时显示账户信息（余额、净值、保证金等），方便交易者监控
pros_en: Provides an intuitive visual trading panel that improves manual trading efficiency
Integrates common functions like quick order placement, SL/TP modification, and batch closing for convenient operation
Real-time display of account information (balance, equity, margin, etc.) for easy trader monitoring
cons: 作为工具面板，不提供自动交易策略，完全依赖交易者手动决策
面板界面可能在不同分辨率或DPI设置下显示异常
缺乏详细的用户文档和使用说明，新用户上手门槛较高
cons_en: As a utility panel, it does not provide automated trading strategies and relies entirely on the trader's manual decisions
The panel interface may display incorrectly under different screen resolutions or DPI settings
Lacks detailed user documentation and usage instructions, resulting in a steep learning curve for new users
improvements: 增加一键设置风险比例自动计算手数的功能，提升资金管理便利性
支持面板主题自定义和响应式布局，适配不同屏幕环境
improvements_en: Add a one-click risk percentage auto-lot calculation feature to improve money management convenience
Support custom panel themes and responsive layout to adapt to different screen environments

risk_points: 该工具不自动开仓，无策略风险
手动操作时需注意误触下单按钮导致非预期交易
risk_points_en: This tool does not open positions automatically, so there is no strategy risk
When operating manually, care must be taken to avoid accidental clicks on order buttons leading to unintended trades
